claim: Unmodified KirbyAmClient.game_watcher running on native mGBA memory through a local audited request adapter; complete synthetic AP histories and captured outbound messages. Not a live AP server or BizHawk Lua/connector witness.

substitutions: Faithful local SimpleNamespace context provides synthetic server/socket identities, authenticated fixture identity, real NetUtils.NetworkItem objects, empty server checked-location sets, send_msgs capture and update_death_link capture. No external network is used.
Actual validate_rom initializes the client; production initialize_client, on_package, game_watcher, reconciliation, delivery and both ownership synchronizers are not replaced or monkeypatched.

Slot copy adds phone_protocol_version=1 and starting_phone_access=false for the already enabled isolated fixture. Production generated slot and ROM keep Phone disabled. Notification options enable_receive_notifications=false and enable_send_notifications=false are consumed by the ordinary settings loader; normal INFO logger configuration leaves debug probes quiet.
Utils.user_path.cached_path selects an isolated private receipt journal. Persistence run copies the successful journal together with its matching native end save.

Transport READ maps ROM offsets to 0x08000000+offset and System Bus addresses directly to libmGBA busRead8. GUARD compares exact native bytes; WRITE is logged before guarded application through busWrite8. DISPLAY_MESSAGE is captured and acknowledged but not displayed.

Import environment uses AP_TEST_WORLDS=kirbyam, SKIP_REQUIREMENTS_UPDATE=1, unittest before worlds, and disables optional pyximport loading. This restricts unrelated world/dependency loading without changing the production client methods.

Existing mGBA bridge uses its normal no-external-BIOS startup, discards audio buffers, and reads native video for private screenshots. No save state is loaded; initial battery_restore is the copied native save before frame zero.

Native execution advances only by recorded controller frames between watcher polls; transport batches do not advance emulator time. This is a deterministic same-process adapter, not asynchronous network-race or BizHawk transport coverage.

Incomplete-history control changes the socket and supplies an index-one ReceivedItems event before a complete replay, without a Connected callback at that boundary. Later reconnect controls use the real Connected callback and event-loop drain: omitted ReceivedItems clears the stale list, while same-batch index-zero replay wins.
Captured LocationChecks are not acknowledged by a simulated server, so their retries are expected; no server acceptance or roundtrip is claimed.
